version.changelog: 恢复kg start加载命令; kg检查改为建清单→显示表格→询问是否执行→是则执行/否则删清单; D流程更新为清单模式

llm.summary: This is a coherent Obsidian note-organizing skill, but it deserves review because it can automatically edit many vault files and query public web/image services using note-derived topics.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts match the stated purpose of organizing an Obsidian knowledge graph, including classifying notes, creating relationship notes, de-duplicating, and fixing metadata.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill makes several operations mandatory, including web/image search and broad relationship-building, rather than consistently asking for user approval before network lookups or large vault changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No code files, install scripts, binaries, environment variables, or credentials are present; this is an instruction-only skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The requested behavior is mostly purpose-aligned, but it can read and mutate Obsidian notes broadly and can send note-derived search terms to external services such as Baidu Images, Google Images, and Wikipedia.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill stores task checklists under a working directory and reuses them across sessions, which is disclosed and workflow-related but should be reviewed because persisted task files can influence later actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want this skill to actively reorganize an Obsidian vault. Back up the vault first, review bulk-operation checklists, and be cautious with private notes because the workflow may search public web/image services for note-related topics unless you instruct the agent not to.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to use public web/image search based on note content as a mandatory part of the normal workflow, without an explicit approval step or clear limits on what note-derived information may be searched externally.
evidence.snippet: 读内容时判断是否需配说明性图片：... 主动搜索网络嵌入 ... 搜索来源：百度图片 / Google Images / Wikipedia

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Make web/image search opt-in, ask before searching from private notes, avoid sending sensitive titles or content to search engines, and review inserted external links.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note titles or topics could be exposed to public search providers, and external image URLs could be inserted into the vault.

evidence.explanation: The skill is explicitly designed to create, modify, and delete multiple Obsidian files. This is aligned with its purpose, but it is high-impact local file mutation and should be used with backups or review.
evidence.snippet: 任务预期产生 ≥5 个文件操作（新建/修改/删除）时，必须先建清单再动手 ... 按执行清单步骤逐条执行

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Back up the vault before large runs, review generated execution checklists, and prefer a dry-run/check mode before applying bulk edits.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A mistaken classification or relationship decision could change or delete many notes in the Obsidian vault.

evidence.explanation: The skill persists task state in `_working/` and reads it on later invocations. This is disclosed and useful for recovery, but those files become persistent context that can steer future actions.
evidence.snippet: 中途中止 → 清单文件保留，下次会话恢复 ... search_files target=files, pattern=*完成检查清单*, path=_working/

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Keep the `_working/` directory trusted, review unfinished checklists before resuming, and delete obsolete task files.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Stale or manually edited checklist files could cause the agent to resume or prioritize unintended work.

evidence.explanation: The skill tries to make itself the required workflow for Obsidian-note tasks. This is related to its purpose, but it broadens when the skill should influence the agent.
evidence.snippet: 打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill ... 其他 agent 执行命令前必须先 `kg start` 加载本 skill ... 自动触发本 skill

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the skill only for vaults where this KG note method is desired, and explicitly disable or avoid it for unrelated Obsidian editing.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may apply this note-organizing method more broadly than the user expected for Obsidian-related work.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses broad local file operations and strong workflow-control instructions, but these are mostly aligned with its Obsidian organization purpose.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, privileged account access, or special OS permissions are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The main concern is mandatory public web/image searching from note-derived content, plus persistent task files that can affect later sessions.
